prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Korean woman — the personification of Daejeon — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Daejeon as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Daejeon with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the inner gallery of the colossal ring-shaped fusion reactor of her far-future city at night — the small artificial sun glowing gold behind curved clear shielding, rings of light pulsing along the walls and the whole basin city lit gold far below the windows
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: an artificial-sun-keeper look fitted to her body — a sleek pale cropped flight top and high-cut shorts traced with fine golden lines laid out in rows like fields seen from above, a glowing ring collar of golden plasma light circling her bare shoulders, control bands on her forearms and slim light-soled boots, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: kneeling on one knee, the other foot planted flat in front of her.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a palm-sized glass sphere holding a tiny captive sun of swirling golden plasma, ringed by a thin band of light at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes, mouth firmly closed.
Scene note: she is the keeper of the artificial sun, kneeling on one knee at the gallery rail and steadying the glowing sphere in her palm as she tunes the sun's light to a softer gold

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
